decisions.reason: An existing same-message MODIFY already revises the coded-referral commission references in the approved FAQ and relevant FAQ sections to $20.
The message mentions $20, $18, and $8 for no-referral commissions, so the coded-referral amount change cannot safely determine the no-referral commission amount without clarification.
Changing the coded-referral commission amount does not change ticket quantity, recipient, trigger, or drawing-entry semantics.
The landing-page referral copy still states a $10 coded-referral commission and must be revised to remain consistent with the new $20 amount.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, 34 mints should correspond to 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

A mint still produces a ticket and commission even when no referral code is supplied.

Accounting works correctly on the leaderboards and NFT attributes whenever a code is used. That part is perfect.

Without a referral code, the ticket and commission are assigned randomly, but both must still appear on the leaderboard and in the NFT attributes.

Since your latest fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 7 mints seem to have been recorded correctly, which is great. The earlier missing tickets have not been backfilled, though.

The $18 commissions generated by these no-code buys are also still missing from the leaderboard and NFT attributes.

My screenshot shows an NFT with 9 tickets but only 4 x $20 commissions. That should be impossible because every ticket comes with a $18 commission.

The leaderboard screenshot accounts for only 15 tickets and 12 x $8 commissions from 34 total mints. Regardless of whether a referral code was supplied, 34 mints should produce 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

value_updates.mechanics_tease_text: Emphasize the $20 unlimited, instant commission and the opportunity to win $900 every 750 sales without repetitive or overly sales-focused wording.
value_updates.commission_copy_requirement: Make the $20 amount, unlimited nature, and immediate timing clear.

decisions.reason: The commission amount change does not alter the referral code source, persistence, or display locations.
The coded-referral commission amount does not change no-referral ticket quantity, allocation trigger, or weighted recipient selection.
The commission amount change does not affect referral eligibility or the prohibition on self-referrals.
The metadata requirement governs accurate visibility and attribute sourcing but contains no coded-referral commission amount that must be changed.
The coded-referral commission amount change does not entail a change to the Small Block prize amount, winners, trigger, or pool allocation.
Badge thresholds and award semantics remain unchanged by the commission amount decision.

Applying a $20 affiliate commission to the current $30 split would conflict with the retained $12 founder share and $8 prize-pool share, and the source does not provide a reconciled replacement allocation.
The coded-referral commission amount does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT transfer.
